propositions: A standing eval spec for the concurrency code-review overlay must be authored to prevent silent regression of recall/precision behavior established by a traced-bug corpus.

The spec must include at least 2 scored recall cases (unlocked twin, check-then-act TOCTOU) each with provenance commits, at least 3 scored no-fire cases, and the hard FP control (probe-then-skip with real lock).
The fail-open guard case (R3) must be present as a non-gating documented stretch comment block with provenance and rationale, not as a scored case.
The spec must enforce `gate: at_least(2)` over `epochs: 3` as the only per-run tolerance, and a header comment must clarify that `coverage_threshold` is a run-success floor.
The command `rebar prompt eval code-review-concurrency` must exit 0, validating well-formed spec, resolvable scorers/gate, unique dataset ids, and balanced fire/pass datasets.
